from sample_repo import OrderService, OrderStatus, Side


def test_cancel_all_only_live_orders_of_the_account():
    svc = OrderService()
    a = svc.place('acc-1', 'SYN-A', Side.BUY, 5)
    b = svc.place('acc-1', 'SYN-B', Side.SELL, 5)
    c = svc.place('acc-2', 'SYN-A', Side.BUY, 5)
    svc.cancel(b.order_id)
    assert svc.cancel_all('acc-1') == [a.order_id]
    assert c.status is OrderStatus.NEW
